target_customer: Non-technical professionals and small teams who want to automate browser and app workflows without code
problem: Repetitive browser based work is hard to automate without engineers. 100x lets users record a workflow once and turn it into an AI agent that can be shared or monetized.
business_model: Self serve no-code automation platform, likely subscription or usage based (pricing not published)
product_category: No-code AI agent and browser automation platform

founders.name: Shardul Lavekar
founders.background_notes: Led AI products at Airtel X Labs per YC and a directory profile.

founders.name: Parth Mudgal
previous_startups: Unlogged (YC S22), automated testing for Java developers
founders.background_notes: Described as building AI powered browser automation tools.

technical_complexity.rationale: Recording browser actions and replaying them with an LLM layer is standard engineering with brittle parts such as changing page structure. Evidence is limited to the YC description and the site tagline 'Record once and Automate forever'.

defensibility.rationale: Browser macro and no-code automation tools were many and easy to copy, and no distinct data or network effect is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Zapier and similar automation platforms were well resourced and moving into AI agents. No source documents what they did against 100x specifically.

market_need_then: No dated source on demand at founding was found. The no-code automation category was established by workflow tools such as Zapier, which a directory description of 100x compares itself to.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct tagline: Record once and Automate forever.

brand_strength.rationale: A branding search found no press or community coverage of 100x.bot. The name collides with 100X.VC, a prompt-to-SaaS product on Product Hunt and others, which hurts findability.

outcome_analysis: 100x is still active with a team of three. No funding round, revenue or customer figures could be verified, so the outcome is unclear. The founders are repeat founders, one with an acquired startup, which helps credibility, but the category was crowded and the product has little documented traction.
notes: YC lists Summer 2022 but also a 2024 founding year, which conflicts; the Summer 2022 batch label may be a data quirk. A hiring post claims backing from Accel and Inventus, unverified and not recorded as a round. Outcome search found nothing about 100x. No dated competitor sources were found, so the list is empty.
